spans.text: Atha kho aññatarassa bhikkhuno evaṁ cetaso parivitakko udapādi: Now at that time one of the monks had the thought, “iti kira, bho, rūpaṁ anattā, vedanā anattā, saññā anattā, saṅkhārā anattā, viññāṇaṁ anattā; “So it seems, worthy sir, that form, feeling, perception, choices, and consciousness are not-self.
